page.overview:
Who is Aeson the Fallen?

Aeson the Fallen is a former king of the Baersonling tribe of Norsca who mutated into a massive Mutalith Vortex Beast during the End Times. A Mutalith is a Chaos beast comprised of grasping tentacles, a great vortex of magical energies and which is afflicted by an ever-creeping insanity.

Now a twisted mass of tentacles and teeth, Aeson remembers only enough of his former life as a mortal man to follow his former tribesmen into battle, and dimly, upon smelling the blood of the slain, the frenzies to which it drove him. Aeson would weep for what he has lost, were he capable any longer of comprehending how far he has fallen.

As Aeson lumbers forward, the swirling portal of Chaos energies upon his back ushers madness and death upon his friends and foes alike. Those who cannot find shelter from this raging tempest of arcane power, a maelstrom of pure change, are sure to wither and break before its every wave. Aeson cares not.
